_comment: Merge into site_config.json on Frappe Cloud (Site → Configuration). No secrets in git.
_comment_license: LICENSED-OPERATOR MODE: remove lms_sandbox_end_date and set the four lms_operator_* keys below to switch from sandbox to production. The app refuses to process money-movement events in production mode until lms_operator_licence_validated = true.
lms_risk_disclosure: Loans involve credit risk. Terms and fees apply.
_comment_brand_section: BRAND (the operator's name, tagline, footer, colour). The login page, portal navbar, desk chrome, and email subjects all read from these. Set them with: bench --site <site> execute lms_saas.utils.brand.set_brand --kwargs '{"portal_title": "Your Brand"}'. See docs/BRAND_QUICKSTART.md for the full recipe.
_comment_footer: Set lms_brand_footer_text to "" to hide the portal footer. Omit it to default to Powered by {lms_brand_portal_title}.
_comment_brand_assets: Optional brand assets. If unset, the bundled mark + favicon are used.
_comment_idle: Portal idle auto-logout (minutes). Warning appears ~2 minutes before. Set 0 to disable.
_comment_email: Live outgoing SMTP credentials. When these are set, the post-deploy script (frappe-cloud-update.sh) automatically creates/updates the default outgoing Email Account and retries the stuck Email Queue. Without these, every email (payment reminders, repayment confirmations, welcome emails, digests) lands in the Email Queue as 'Error'. Use an app-specific password (not your login password) for SMTP auth.
_comment_twilio: Twilio SMS provider keys. Account SID, Auth Token, and From number must also be saved on the LMS Twilio Settings desk page. The auth token is stored encrypted in Frappe's Password table.
